reason: Official FGDC metadata defines valid PercentCover estimates in the observed range 12-90 percent and defines '.' as no estimate. No valid 0-percent/recorded-absence state is defined, so next-year recorded loss cannot be constructed without treating missing estimation as absence.
interpretation: Alaska v2 is structurally suitable for repeated quantitative cover analysis but cannot test the frozen Tampa endpoint of next-year recorded loss. It neither supports nor contradicts the early-warning hypothesis.
no_rescue: Do not reinterpret '.' as absence, do not invent a cover=0 state, and do not change the endpoint after inspecting this metadata.
